# KASH Aster 4626/7540 vaults

Network: Arbitrum One (42161)

Vault = ERC-20 share token. No separate KASH token. No Merkle proofs.

## Addresses (env)

- ETH vault / share: NEXT_PUBLIC_KASH_YIELD_ETH_ADDRESS (also KASH_TOKEN_ETH)
- BTC vault / share: NEXT_PUBLIC_KASH_YIELD_BTC_ADDRESS (also KASH_TOKEN_BTC)
- asset ETH: WETH 0x82aF49447D8a07e3bd95BD0d56f35241523fBab1
- asset BTC: wBTC 0x2f2a2543B76A4166549F7aaB2e75Bef0aefC5B0f
- optional USDC pipe ETH: NEXT_PUBLIC_KASH_PIPE_USDC_ETH
- optional USDC pipe BTC: NEXT_PUBLIC_KASH_PIPE_USDC_BTC
- optional USDT pipe ETH: NEXT_PUBLIC_KASH_PIPE_USDT_ETH
- optional USDT pipe BTC: NEXT_PUBLIC_KASH_PIPE_USDT_BTC
- USDC: 0xaf88d065e77c8cC2239327C5EDb3A432268e5831 (6 dec)
- USDT: 0xFd086bC7CD5C481DCC9C85ebE478A1C0b69FCbb9 (6 dec)

## ABI

One per vault: frontend/lib/contracts/kashVaultEthABI.ts and kashVaultBtcABI.ts. Do not merge.
Pipe (USDC/USDT): frontend/lib/contracts/kashPipeABI.ts

## Deposit

ETH: requestDepositETH(controller) payable, or approve WETH then requestDeposit(assets, controller, owner)
BTC: approve wBTC then requestDeposit(assets, controller, owner)
Optional USDC/USDT Pipe: approve the Pipe, then requestDepositStable(amount, minAssetOut, controller). minAssetOut must be non-zero. Pipe swaps stable→asset and calls requestDeposit(assetOut, user, pipe). Claim shares on the vault — the Pipe cannot claim deposits. Not a second vault asset.
requestId = getCurrentBatchCycle()
Watch DepositRequest. No shares yet.

## Claim deposit

After BatchProcessed and claimOpenAt: deposit(assets, receiver[, controller]) or mint(shares, receiver[, controller])
FIFO oldest cycle. preview* reverts. maxDeposit is claimable, not a deposit cap.

## Redeem

requestRedeem(shares, controller, owner) — vault locks shares; N+1 hold (lastMintCycle)
Claim asset: redeem(shares, receiver[, controller]) pays WETH/wBTC
Claim stable: vault.setOperator(pipe, true) once, then pipe.claimRedeemStable(shares, minStableOut, receiver). minStableOut must be non-zero (quoteStableOut). requestRedeemStable(shares, controller) is equivalent to requestRedeem with the Pipe as operator.

## Reads

paused, isUserWindow, isProcessingWindow, getNAV, feeBps, getCurrentBatchCycle
pendingDepositRequest(cycle, controller), claimableDepositRequest(cycle, controller)
asset(), share(), totalAssets(), convertToShares, convertToAssets, balanceOf

## Events

DepositRequest, RedeemRequest, Deposit, Withdraw, BatchProcessed, OperatorSet, Paused, Unpaused, BotAddressSet, NavCorrected, NavMonitorTripped
